# Air Legends Cooling & Heating

> Heating & air conditioning based in Tomball, Texas. Air Legends Cooling & Heating is a women-owned HVAC company in Tomball. Reviewers say Jamie and Josh Reed show up on time, send photos, explain every step and often have the AC running within hours.

## Services
- AC repair: Same-day and next-morning repairs, with photos and a plain explanation before any work.
- System replacement: Full AC and heating replacements, set and running in a short day.
- Coil replacement: Leaking condenser and indoor coils replaced and the system recharged.
- Heating & gas leaks: Furnace and heater repair, and gas leaks found and fixed on the same visit.
- Maintenance plans: A plan that keeps systems checked, drains clear and equipment lasting longer.

## About
Air Legends Cooling & Heating, also listed as Air Legends HVAC Group, is a women-owned small business in Tomball. Jamie leads the team, Josh Reed is the lead technician and Carole runs the office from the shop at 17413 FM 2920. The crew repairs and replaces AC and heating systems, swaps condenser coils, fixes drain lines and finds gas leaks. Technicians send photos and walk you through the problem before they start, and many customers stay on the maintenance plan for years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you answer after hours in Tomball?
  A: Yes. One family reached Carole at 9 PM after smelling burning plastic, and Jamie was there first thing the next morning.
- Q: How long does a condenser coil replacement take?
  A: One reviewer had a leaking condenser coil swapped and the system recharged in about two and a half hours.
- Q: Will you show me what's wrong before you fix it?
  A: Yes. Technicians send pictures and explain the work in detail before they go ahead.
- Q: Do you offer a maintenance plan?
  A: Yes. Customers on the Air Legends maintenance plan say it keeps their systems running longer.
- Q: Can you give a second opinion?
  A: Yes. Call for a second look at a repair or replacement quote.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 6 PM, with calls returned quickly when the AC goes out.
